booklet

sections · 0.2.0 · aj-s-booklet

The week's reflection as a small booklet, one leaf at a time below desktop and open at a spread of two from the container's 1200: its leaves (the leaf component, rendered here from the page's data so a static screen opens on the right one), their paper and lift, the stitches across the fold, the ribbon, and the pager under it (arrows and "Page 2 of 6"). Its script turns the leaves: arrows, a swipe, a tap on a leaf's outer thirds on a phone, the Left and Right keys; leaves out of view are inert.
